independentFindings.subject: 摘要职责与生命周期
independentFindings.finding: ProjectManifestSummary is an owned compact projection. Public fields and Serde allow direct construction, so only parser results demonstrate its validation path. Byte entry validates size and UTF-8, text entry validates existing text length before TOML, complexity, DTO and semantic admission; Runtime-only validation and resource existence remain consumer responsibilities.

independentFindings.subject: 迁移与调用顺序
independentFindings.finding: Project loader rejects future source versions before MigrationChain::migrate_value; v0 is rejected, v1 supplies established defaults, and v2 advances to v3. Loaded.migrated_from preserves source provenance. Root read current generic chain execute/validate: complete chain is checked before indexed step calls, but its unrelated future-version TODO remains unresolved.

independentFindings.subject: 消费者边界
independentFindings.finding: Runtime load.rs bounds input, rejects migrated input, then decodes and validates the full manifest. Editor preflight bounds file read and digests the source, parses summary, and creates the Runtime manifest only for current format. Hub validation and recent-project loading consume summary as compact project identity; their caller bodies do not turn this parser into full Runtime admission.
